metric.semantic_locality.basis_note: This is a single-language shard (Python only), computed on the all-Python-fragments basis (43 of 44 probes scored, F20.P2 excluded as NONE/N-1). Per capability_universe.json interaction_with_quality_metrics, the runner is responsible for merging all ten language shards and republishing the figure additionally on the cross-language common basis (probes where all ten languages have a fragment, FULL or PARTIAL) once every language shard is available; this shard cannot determine that common basis on its own and does not claim to.
metric.semantic_locality.caveat: Lookup counts above are produced by expert language-neutral annotation against the frozen semantic_site_matrix.json rows and capability_universe.json canonical_task text for Python, following the R5/R9/R10 authoring rules; they are not mechanically extracted from compiled/run fragments in this packet-only worker context. No probe was dropped, reweighted, or substituted outside the named R9 exceptions.
metric.semantic_locality.methodology_basis: semantic_compression.md section C: 'Measure how much non-local context must be inspected to determine the semantic facts of each probe. Record the number of required external semantic lookups or declaration-graph hops ... Lower lookup cost is better.'
metric.semantic_locality.normalization_formula: score = 100 / (1 + mean_lookups_per_scored_probe). Lower raw lookup cost -> higher (better) normalized score, 100 is the theoretical ceiling for zero-lookup fragments. This is a locally documented monotonic normalization chosen because the frozen methodology specifies the direction (lower is better) and a 0-100 scale but does not freeze a specific formula; it is recorded here for audit and must be applied identically to every language shard.

metric.semantic_locality.unit_of_count: one lookup per distinct externally-given declaration (variable declaration, callee signature, type declaration, imported definition, or global configuration) that a fact within the measured_fragment genuinely depends on, per capability_universe.json authoring rule R5. Lookups that are optional/for extra detail are not counted, per the matrix's exclusion_criterion.
